title: Prefer note titles in wiki links

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict: Caught.** Maintained controller proof caught one plausible loss of title precedence. This finding is limited to the observed title-plus-alias collision path and its six authored link forms.

**Story and revision.** `SEED-122#prefer-note-titles-in-wiki-links`, from `.planning/seeds/SEED-122-prefer-note-titles-in-wiki-links.md`; completed implementation `e257b144d1e9120528922da0f5dc045acb6c9d6d`. The selected promise is that a readable, available unique title resolves despite colliding aliases in body links, supported YAML scalar/list values, qualified links, and labeled links.

**Fault.** In `backend/src/main/java/com/odde/donut/services/WikiLinkNoteCandidates.java:49`, replaced the title-first return in `titleOrAlias` with a distinct union of readable title and alias candidates:

```java
List<Note> allMatches = new ArrayList<>(byTitle);
allMatches.addAll(aliasTargets(notebookName, noteTitle).stream().filter(readable).toList());
return distinctByNoteId(allMatches);
```

This one semantic fault lets alias collisions make a unique title ambiguous. Maintained fixtures and assertions were unchanged.

**Maintained assertion that caught it.** `NoteControllerShowWikiLinkTitlePrecedenceTests.selectsTitleBeforeAliasesAcrossAuthoredLinkForms`, line 47, asserts that every destination ID equals the title note ID. Its fixture has notebook `Colors`, title `color`, two other notes aliased `color`, and six authored forms. The earlier six-link count assertion passed; the destination assertion failed with:

```text
Expected: every item is <490>
     but: an item was null
```

**Independent wrong-behavior observation.** A temporary, assertion-free controller witness reproduced that fixture separately and inspected the actual `showNote` response. Its captured output was:

```text
INTENT_WITNESS expectedTitleId=208 linkCount=6
INTENT_WITNESS authored=color|Scalar resolution=AMBIGUOUS destination=null display=Scalar
INTENT_WITNESS authored=color|List resolution=AMBIGUOUS destination=null display=List
INTENT_WITNESS authored=color resolution=AMBIGUOUS destination=null display=color
INTENT_WITNESS authored=color|Read this resolution=AMBIGUOUS destination=null display=Read this
INTENT_WITNESS authored=Colors:color resolution=AMBIGUOUS destination=null display=Colors:color
INTENT_WITNESS authored=COLOR|Case resolution=AMBIGUOUS destination=null display=Case
```

This establishes the promised destination actually went wrong at the controller boundary, separately from the maintained assertion failure.

**Runs.** Every stage used the identical repository-required full command, `./scripts/run.sh pnpm backend:test_only`, in isolated scratch `/tmp/doughnut-intent-coverage-122-1794389081`. No filtered suite, formatting, linting, commit, or push was used.

| Faulted | Exit 1; migration `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 25s`; `3112 tests completed, 6 failed, 2 skipped`; `BUILD FAILED in 2m 16s` | 627 suites including the one scratch witness; 3,112 tests; 6 maintained failures; 0 errors; 2 skips | 162.748 s |

All six deliberate failures concern title/alias precedence: the selected six-form assertion, the existing title-collision assertion, title property selection, missing title property handling, shortest shorthand authoring, and the live alias-to-title transition. These scratch failures are not reported as production defects.

**Restoration and isolation.** The checkout initially had empty Git status. A `finally` handler restored the original production bytes and removed the scratch witness before restored proof. Source SHA-256 before and after was `d01e1ea4f771051928fd1169c5c3d2545b4d25847a5cf816bc02ea07a618f72b`; byte equality, original Git status equality, and witness removal passed both before and after the restored run. Public worktree setup passed with separate writable dependency/cache state. An initial cache-copy setup command rejected GNU `cp -c`; using `/bin/cp` corrected it before any tests or fault. The disposable database `doughnut_wt_f9a2701aefdd4e0a947f6db67521ec70_test` passed the retirement idle check and was dropped. The scratch worktree and private caches were removed. All owned commands reached terminal results; no watches remain. The execution checkout, installed skills, and project defaults were unchanged.

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing destination assertion for this promise. This observation supports no assertion strengthening or additional journey proof for the checked path.
